about: Evidence each gate needs before it can LOCK (stagegate.mjs). measured = a tool run that must exit 0; made = the maker's own files; judged = by: agent:<id> or person:<name>, never the maker; approved = Kai in review/approvals.json. A film may add evidence in review/gates.local.json, never remove it.

evidence.why: the treatment (DEVELOP.md [0.2])
the decisions the treatment sets (DEVELOP.md section 5)
a fresh reader picks a hook from thumbnails + first lines and says why (fresh against the thumbnails it judged)
notes from one full-speed viewing with sound, by timecode (PREPRO.md [1.6] story pass)
muted retell, want / obstacle / outcome per beat, with every guess marked
where a viewer would swipe away, by timecode
floor plan per scene: the 180° line and each shot's camera position (image linked inside)
the 7-point camera checklist for every shot, CAM LOCK or FIX
the camera-intent pass by a fresh agent (OUT-1/3/4/5)
style frames on two locked shots (a wide, the climax), checked at phone size
one frame per scene on the intensity curve
every locked shot rendered grey with the real assets beside its animatic panel (STAGE 2 [2.4])
silhouette, phone-size read, colour separation, scale, per asset
per acting shot: think → do → change, and the pose thumbnails Kai approved
board.mjs --judge 3 (lines shown)
each scene scored 1-5 against its feel line, with frames
full-speed, sound on, phone size, UI overlay on: retell + swipe test on the final
retention.mjs: drop-offs mapped to shots, 24 h and 7 d
what to keep, what to fix, and the rules proposed for the skill
the beat outline with but/so links, plants and the vote costs (SCRIPT.md [1.1a])
the fact sheet: claim, lines, source URL, check, the move by you (SCRIPT.md [1.1b])
a fresh fact checker tried to break every claim and number
a fresh skeptic listed every 'but why?', every beat that just happens, and whether the vote is open
a fresh listener heard it once and retold it: numbers kept and lost, where it got lost
a fresh judge compared the last locked script and this one blind (X / Y)
